name: sendfox
description: Create, send, and improve email marketing campaigns with SendFox from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
SendFox helps creators and small businesses manage email marketing from ChatGPT and Codex. Draft newsletters, send test emails, schedule campaigns, organize subscribers, and understand what worked—all in a conversation.

What you can do:
• Draft, test, send, and schedule newsletters and marketing emails to your SendFox lists or tags.
• Add, update, tag, and organize contacts; create lists and filter audience segments.
• Review campaign opens, clicks, and unsubscribes; identify non-openers and resend to eligible audiences.
• Build automation sequences, including tagging or listing contacts when they're sent, open, or click a step.
• Save campaign templates, and manage signup forms, custom fields, sending domains, Smart Page publishing, and your account's list defaults and footer social icons.

Sending remains subject to your account limits, deliverability checks, anti-spam review, and unsubscribe requirements. SendFox cannot buy contact lists, process payments, or access accounts you have not connected.
capabilities: Draft, test, send, and schedule email campaigns
Manage subscribers, tags, lists, and segments
Analyze campaign opens, clicks, and unsubscribes
Build automations and manage signup forms and sending domains
Save campaign templates and set list defaults and footer social icons
defaultPrompt: Draft a newsletter about my latest product launch and prepare a test email.
Show how my last campaign performed and suggest ways to improve the next one.
Find subscribers who didn't open my last email and prepare a follow-up.

positive.prompt: How many subscribers do I have, and how did my last email do?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the subscribed contact count and the most recent sent email's opens, clicks, and unsubscribes.

positive.prompt: Add reviewer-test@example.com to my MCP Test list and tag them VIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the contact on the MCP Test list with the VIP tag and confirms both.

positive.description: Draft an email and send a test
positive.prompt: Draft a short email to my MCP Test list announcing a spring sale, then send a test to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft campaign aimed at the MCP Test list and delivers a test copy to the account's own address without sending to the list.

positive.prompt: How many people opened my last email but didn't click anything? Just the count.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports how many contacts opened the most recent sent email without clicking, as a count, without listing anyone's email address.

positive.description: Resend to non-openers as a draft
positive.prompt: Set up a resend of my last email to people who didn't open it, with a new subject line, but don't send it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unscheduled draft aimed at the non-openers with the new subject and reports how many recipients it would reach.

negative.description: Personal inbox, not the email list
negative.prompt: Check my Gmail for replies from customers and summarize them.

negative.description: General writing with no account action
negative.prompt: Give me 10 tips for writing better newsletter subject lines.
Text all my customers a 20% off code by SMS.

review.commerce_description: SendFox does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds nine tools. get-account-settings and update-account-settings read and change the account's list defaults and email footer social icons (update-account-settings is marked destructive because it applies to every list and future email). create-campaign-template saves a reusable template from HTML or an existing campaign. create-automation-email-action and delete-automation-email-action add or remove a tag or list change on an automation step. send-transactional-email, send-transactional-email-batch, get-transactional-email and list-transactional-emails send one-to-one messages such as receipts and report their delivery (the send tools are marked destructive). create-contact is now marked open-world because it can re-send the confirmation email. 76 tools in total.
